entries.name: memory_store
entries.description: Store a grounded fact in mem20's persistent memory system. You MUST declare epistemic_status: how this claim came to be known. Use 'observed' only for something you directly witnessed or verified (a command's real output, a file that exists). Use 'inferred' for a conclusion drawn from observations, 'agent_generated' for your own prior claim, 'hypothesis' for a guess, 'user_stated' for something the user told you. If the basis is genuinely unknown use 'unlabeled'. For invented/simulated content use memory_simulate_store instead, which keeps fiction in a separate partition.

entries.name: irc_read
entries.description: Read channel messages newer than a sequence cursor. Server noise (MOTD, numerics, joins/parts) is already filtered out before it reaches you, so every message here is real conversation. Pass back the 'latest_seq' from the previous call as 'since'. entries.name: lie_seal_session
entries.description: Seal the live session into an immutable package, write it to grounded memory, and optionally journal a braid event.

entries.name: lie_list_sessions
entries.description: List active behavioural-signal sessions

entries.name: ops_registry
entries.description: Report the tool registry's real counts and generation time, so an operator can tell whether the tool list they are reading is current.

entries.name: ops_cli_audit
entries.description: List every console script declared by a mem20* pyproject, with the package that declares it and whether the entry point resolves. A declared-but-missing script is reported as a finding.

entries.name: ops_wiring
entries.description: Prove mem20ops's cross-subsystem edges by calling each one: toolchest catalog, memory_engine pin_block, mem20kanbanz sha256, mem20corez CharMLP, mem20cliz build_envelope, mem20verify discover_packages. Returns per-edge ok/result.

entries.name: verify_drift
entries.description: Compare what the tool registry claims exists with what is actually on disk. Reports subsystems listed but missing, and directories on disk that no one listed. Drift is reported in both directions.

entries.name: verify_tests
entries.description: Run each package's own test suite from its own root and report real pass/fail counts. A package whose suite cannot be run is reported as an error, never as a pass.

entries.name: verify_lint
entries.description: Run the AST linters that catch known-shipped defect classes (late-binding closures, import-time sys.exit, registry/dispatch mismatch) across the estate's source.

entries.name: verify_wiring
entries.description: Prove mem20verify's cross-subsystem edges by calling each one: toolchest catalog, memory_engine pin_block, mem20kanbanz sha256, mem20ops declared_scripts, mem20corez CharMLP, mem20cliz build_envelope. Returns per-edge ok/result.

entries.name: toolchest_inventory
entries.description: Query the mem20 tool registry: every MCP tool, every CLI binary on PATH, and every native mem20 subsystem, with real runtime status. action=list filters by kind/category; action=search matches names and descriptions; action=show returns one entry; action=stats returns counts.

entries.name: toolchest_wiring
entries.description: Prove the tool registry's cross-subsystem edges by calling each one: memory_engine pin_block, mem20kanbanz sha256, mem20ops declared_scripts, mem20corez CharMLP, mem20cliz build_envelope, mem20verify discover_packages. Returns per-edge ok/result so a broken edge is visible, not assumed.

entries.name: corez_infer
entries.description: Run real inference on the native character MLP tensor engine. Returns the generated continuation plus the real per-token logits shape and latency measured during the call.

entries.name: corez_quantize
entries.description: Quantize a real tensor to int8/int4/fp16 and report the measured reconstruction error and compression ratio. The error is computed from the actual dequantized values, not estimated.

entries.name: corez_evaluate
entries.description: Evaluate a freshly built model on the built-in corpus and return real accuracy, perplexity and latency measured from execution.

entries.name: corez_wiring
entries.description: Prove mem20corez's cross-subsystem edges by calling each one: toolchest catalog, memory_engine pin_block, mem20kanbanz sha256, mem20ops declared_scripts, mem20cliz build_envelope, mem20verify discover_packages. Returns per-edge ok/result.

entries.name: webhook_verify
entries.description: Verify a webhook delivery's freshness, HMAC signature, event time and payload credential class. Returns the estate's verdicts rather than raising.

entries.name: webhook_deliver
entries.description: Verify, admit and deliver a webhook event once per idempotency key. A duplicate is skipped, and a payload carrying a credential is refused.

entries.name: webhook_replay
entries.description: Re-deliver a JSONL event log, refusing when mem20verify reports the store cannot round-trip.

entries.name: webhook_route_capabilities
entries.description: List the capabilities a route may target, read from toolchest's catalog.

entries.name: webhook_doctor
entries.description: Probe the six estate projects the receiver is wired to.

entries.name: kilnz_status
entries.description: Report whether the mem20kilnz asset kiln is importable and which mem20 subsystems its build gate wires to.

entries.name: kilnz_ground
entries.description: Read grounded facts about an asset family before a build. Simulated content is excluded by memory_engine's firewall.

entries.name: kilnz_gate
entries.description: Judge a build result before the asset ships: epistemic veto (mem20crewz), AST lint (mem20verify), fidelity/divergence (mem20dreamz) and corpus distance (mem20corez), grounded against memory_engine. Returns a per-subsystem report and a shippable verdict.

entries.name: kilnz_budget
entries.description: Check a triangle count against the authored budget table for an asset family, at a detail tier and LOD.

entries.name: dreamz_status
entries.description: Report whether the mem20dreamz dream engine is importable and which mem20 subsystems its promotion gate wires to.

entries.name: dreamz_ground
entries.description: Read what the estate already knows about a seed from memory_engine, so a dream does not reinvent an existing tool.

entries.name: dreamz_gate
entries.description: Judge a dream candidate before promotion: epistemic veto (mem20crewz), AST lint (mem20verify), asset budget (mem20kilnz) and corpus distance (mem20corez). Returns a per-subsystem report and a promotable verdict.

entries.name: dreamz_estate
entries.description: Installed vs claimed vs phantom subsystems: what exists on disk versus what braid merely asserts.

entries.name: crewz_status
entries.description: Report whether the mem20crewz crew runtime is importable and which mem20 subsystems its governor wires to.

entries.name: crewz_ground
entries.description: Read grounded facts a crew should know before it starts. Simulated content is excluded by memory_engine's firewall.

entries.name: crewz_govern
entries.description: Judge a crew output before it ships: AST lint (mem20verify), fidelity/divergence (mem20dreamz), asset budget (mem20kilnz) and corpus distance (mem20corez), grounded against memory_engine. Returns a per-subsystem report and a clear verdict.

entries.name: crewz_guard
entries.description: Run the crew's own epistemic veto over a set of fact ids: may a plan rest on these facts, given their labels.

entries.name: agentz_status
entries.description: Report whether the mem20agentz agent platform is importable and which mem20 subsystems its grounded-turn pipeline wires to.

entries.name: agentz_ground
entries.description: Read grounded facts for a topic from memory_engine before an agent reasons. Simulated content is excluded by the engine.

entries.name: agentz_review
entries.description: Review an answer against its brief using the wider estate: epistemic veto (mem20crewz), fidelity/divergence (mem20dreamz), AST lint (mem20verify), asset budget (mem20kilnz) and char-MLP perplexity (mem20corez). Returns a per-subsystem report.

entries.name: agentz_run
entries.description: Run one conversational turn through the mem20agentz AgentCore loop, then review the result with the estate's verifiers.

entries.name: job_status
entries.description: Check the status of a background mem20 job started by a long-running tool. Returns running/ok/error with the result when done.

entries.name: job_wait
entries.description: Block until a background mem20 job completes (or timeout_ms elapses) and return its status/result. Use on job_id returned by a long-running tool.
